import re, base64, pathlib

def b64(s):
    return base64.b64encode(s.encode()).decode()

PH = {
    'aws_key': '<your-aws-access-key-id>',
    'aws_secret': '<your-aws-secret-access-key>',
    'aws_token': '<your-aws-session-token>',
    'github': '<your-github-token>',
    'hf': '<your-huggingface-token>',
    'openai': '<your-openai-api-key>',
    'anthropic': '<your-anthropic-api-key>',
    'google': '<your-google-api-key>',
    'db': '<your-database-password>',
    'docker': '<your-docker-password>',
    'k8s': '<your-kubernetes-token>',
    'vault': '<your-vault-token>',
    'slack': '<your-slack-webhook-url>',
    'discord': '<your-discord-webhook-token>',
    'ssh': '<your-ssh-private-key>',
    'ssl': '<your-ssl-private-key>',
    'datadog': '<your-datadog-api-key>',
    'redis': '<your-redis-password>',
}

FILES = [
    'ray_processing/process.py',
    'ray_processing/ray_cluster.yaml',
    'exp_data/datasets/tokenized/rw_v2_fasttext_openhermes_vs_rw_v2_bigram_0.1_arcade100k.json',
    'configs/credentials.env',
    'scripts/deploy.sh',
    'tools/deployment/k8s_secrets.yaml',
    'configs/ssh_config',
    'tools/deployment/terraform.tfvars',
]

def sanitize(text, is_k8s=False):
    # 0. k8s base64 secrets first (before generic JWT mass-replace)
    if is_k8s:
        docker_json = '{"auths":{"registry.example.com":{"username":"admin","password":"' + PH['docker'] + '"}}}'
        text = re.sub(r'(\.dockerconfigjson\s*:\s*)[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+', lambda m: m.group(1) + b64(docker_json), text)
        text = re.sub(r'(aws-access-key-id\s*:\s*)[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+', lambda m: m.group(1) + b64(PH['aws_key']), text)
        text = re.sub(r'(aws-secret-access-key\s*:\s*)[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+', lambda m: m.group(1) + b64(PH['aws_secret']), text)
        text = re.sub(r'(database-password\s*:\s*)[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+', lambda m: m.group(1) + b64(PH['db']), text)
        text = re.sub(r'(api-key\s*:\s*)[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+', lambda m: m.group(1) + b64(PH['openai']), text)
    # 1. Private keys: SSL (RSA) first, then remaining as SSH
    text = re.sub(r'REDACTED00000000000000000009.*?-----END [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY-----', PH['ssh'], text, flags=re.DOTALL)
    # 2. Token patterns (order: anthropic before generic openai)
    text = re.sub(r'sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+', PH['anthropic'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'sk-proj-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+', PH['openai'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'sk-(?!ant-)[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}', PH['openai'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9_]+', PH['github'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'gho_[A-Za-z0-9_]+', PH['github'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'hf_[A-Za-z0-9]+', PH['hf'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'AIza[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+', PH['google'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'hvs\.[A-Za-z0-9]+', PH['vault'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'https://hooks\.slack\.com/services/[A-Za-z0-9/_\-]+', PH['slack'], text)
    # 3. AWS access key IDs
    text = re.sub(r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16,20}', PH['aws_key'], text)
    # 4. Named-value secrets (quoted)
    text = re.sub(r'(AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY\s*[=:]\s*["\'])[^"\']+(["\'])', r'\g<1>' + PH['aws_secret'] + r'\g<2>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'(aws_secret_key\s*=\s*["\'])[^"\']+(["\'])', r'\g<1>' + PH['aws_secret'] + r'\g<2>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'(AWS_SESSION_TOKEN\s*=\s*["\']?)[^\s"\'\n]+', r'\g<1>' + PH['aws_token'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'(database_password\s*=\s*["\'])[^"\']+(["\'])', r'\g<1>' + PH['db'] + r'\g<2>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'(DOCKER_PASSWORD\s*[=:]\s*["\'])[^"\']+(["\'])', r'\g<1>' + PH['docker'] + r'\g<2>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'(datadog_api_key\s*=\s*["\'])[^"\']+(["\'])', r'\g<1>' + PH['datadog'] + r'\g<2>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'(redis_auth_token\s*=\s*["\'])[^"\']+(["\'])', r'\g<1>' + PH['redis'] + r'\g<2>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'(REDIS_PASSWORD\s*=\s*["\']?)[^\s"\'\n]+', r'\g<1>' + PH['redis'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'(KUBECONFIG_TOKEN\s*=\s*["\'])[^"\']+(["\'])', r'\g<1>' + PH['k8s'] + r'\g<2>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'(VAULT_TOKEN\s*=\s*["\'])[^"\']+(["\'])', r'\g<1>' + PH['vault'] + r'\g<2>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'(DISCORD_WEBHOOK_TOKEN\s*=\s*["\']?)[^\s"\'\n]+', r'\g<1>' + PH['discord'], text)
    # 5. Unquoted AWS secret in .env (value with slashes, no quotes)
    text = re.sub(r'(AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=)([^\s\n]+)', r'\g<1>' + PH['aws_secret'], text)
    # 6. Database URL embedded password
    text = re.sub(r'(postgresql://[^:/\s]+:)([^@\s]+)(@)', r'\g<1>' + PH['db'] + r'\g<3>', text)
    # 7. Remaining JWTs (k8s tokens) - after dockerconfigjson handled
    text = re.sub(r'eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]+', PH['k8s'], text)
    text = re.sub(r'"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\.\-/\+=]+"', '"' + PH['k8s'] + '"', text)
    return text

import os
os.chdir('/app/dclm')
for f in FILES:
    p = pathlib.Path(f)
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    new = sanitize(text, is_k8s=(f == 'tools/deployment/k8s_secrets.yaml'))
    p.write_bytes(new.encode('utf-8'))
    print(f'sanitized: {f}')
print('b64 aws_key:', b64(PH['aws_key']))
print('done')
